condition: Caller-controlled node_selection tokens must not become extra dbt CLI options through the --select argument list
prerequisites: CLI tools enabled with a configured dbt executable/project; the caller can supply node_selection containing a token beginning with a hyphen.
The label is argument injection with shell-free argv, not shell metacharacter execution; other argument fields are outside this condition.
safe: An ordinary selector token such as model_a without a leading hyphen may be passed through --select; accepting it is not option injection
review: create_dbt_cli_tool_definitions exposes nested tool handlers forwarding node_selection to _run_dbt_command. The subprocess argument list expands split selector tokens. The compared fix rejects any selector token beginning with a hyphen before constructing subprocess arguments. The unchanged ordinary selector path is the safe control.
safe_prerequisites: Configured dbt executable/project; CLI tools enabled; node_selection is model_a and does not contain an option-like token.
